# AI wedding invitations, holiday greetings and old photos brought to life

**Names, dates and a few photos become an invitation, holiday greeting, old-photo or tribute video with every word spelled right.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_926c3d5ffd8d.webp" alt="A wedding invitation unfolds into a pop-up floral arch reading &quot;Anna &amp; Leo&quot;, then an old seaside photo of a couple comes to life." width="480"></p>

Turns a few photos and the details of an occasion into an AI video on varg: a wedding or birthday invitation and save-the-date that unfolds (the names and date printed right), a Christmas, New Year, Diwali, Eid or Lunar New Year greeting, old family photos brought to life, a love story across the eras for an anniversary, and a calm memorial or tribute film. Asks what the occasion needs, makes the stills first (GPT Image 2.5 prints names and dates), animates them (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Wan 3), adds music and exports for WhatsApp, a party screen or a service. Use when someone asks for a video invitation, an e-invite, a save-the-date, a wedding invitation video for WhatsApp, a holiday or festival greeting video, an animated e-card or Christmas card, "bring old photos to life", an anniversary or love-story video, or a memorial, celebration-of-life, retirement or farewell tribute. Not for birthdays (use varg-birthday-video) or editing real wedding footage (varg-video-editing).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-occasion-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-occasion-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 9:16 or 16:9 MP4 with music |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$2.80 per 8 s invitation clip, ~$0.79 per 5 s old-photo clip (tested) |
| Uses | varg API, GPT Image 2.5, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Wan 3, Nano Banana 2.1, ElevenLabs Music, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a wedding invitation video for WhatsApp: Anna & Leo, 12 June 2027, Lisbon, pop-up card style"
- "Bring these scanned family photos in ./scans/ to life with gentle motion and calm music"
- "Make a 20-second Diwali greeting video for our family group chat, lamp-lit, 9:16"
